title: Harness Descriptor
description: The data half of a harness adapter: every declarative value a harness exposes, plus references to named code capabilities (transcript parsers, slug generation, shadow preflight). The write guard is pure data (the [guard] block) rendered by one generic engine. Authored as TOML (harnesses/*.toml), validated after transcoding to JSON. Cross-field invariants (guard/banner lockstep, slug/naming-rule agreement, vocabulary coverage, guard template contracts) are enforced by the Rust loader on top of this schema.

label.description: Kebab-case harness identifier, used in CLI flags, dispatch.json, and staged conditions.json.

skills_dir.description: Project-local staged-skills directory, `/`-separated relative to the repo root (e.g. ".claude/skills"). Optional: a harness without one cannot stage skills natively, so runs fall back to --no-stage (each SKILL.md inlined into its dispatch prompt) with a preflight warning.

config_dirs.description: Harness-owned config directory names (e.g. ".claude"). Feeds the staging sibling filter, guard tamper rules, and stray-write lookbehind.

run.description: Run-option capabilities; absent fields take the baseline defaults (no guard, bootstrap and stage-name allowed without staging).

tools.description: Tool-name vocabulary by role, as the harness's transcripts and hook payloads spell them.

staging.description: Native skill staging: slug shape (template or named capability), naming rules, and prompt phrasing.

slug_template.description: Staged-slug format with {prefix}/{iteration}/{condition}/{skill_name} placeholders. Mutually exclusive with slug_capability.

slug_capability.description: Named code capability generating the staged slug (sanitization/truncation beyond a format string).

stage_name_pattern.description: Regex a stage name must fully match (declarative validate_stage_name).

stage_name_invalid_message.description: Rejection message; {name} is substituted with the offending stage name.

skills_block.description: Harness-native available-skills block: header + one item per skill ({name}/{description}/{path} placeholders) + footer.

transcript.description: Transcript ingest: the events file the CLI dispatch captures, read by exactly one of `parser` (a named code capability, for streams that need stitching) or `extract` (the declarative tier for flat event streams). The exactly-one rule is a Rust loader invariant.

extract.description: Declarative extractor for flat event streams: an equality filter (`where`), final/ordered assistant text picks, a native session-id pick, a flat tool-item mapping, a token reduction, and a duration rule. Streams needing keyed cross-event joins or content coercion are named `parser` capabilities instead. Declare at least one sub-table. Dotted paths descend nested objects only (keys containing literal dots are unaddressable).

tools.description: Flat tool-item mapping: each matching record's item object becomes one tool invocation, in stream order.

where.description: Dotted-path-to-expected-string equality filter; omitted matches every record.

item.description: Dotted path to the tool object within the record; omit when the record itself is the item. Records where the path resolves to nothing or a non-object are skipped.

name_field.description: Field of the item whose string value is the invocation name; records without it are skipped.

skip_names.description: Names that are not tools (message/reasoning items sharing the tool event shape).

args_omit.description: Structural item keys excluded from args; whatever remains (key order preserved) is the args object, null when empty.

result_coalesce.description: Result = first present of these item fields (present-but-null counts), strings verbatim and everything else compact JSON.

final_text.description: Final assistant text: dotted-path string pick over matching records; the last match wins.

where.description: Dotted-path-to-expected-string equality filter; omitted matches every record.

assistant_messages.description: Ordered assistant messages: every matching dotted-path string becomes a transcript event.

where.description: Dotted-path-to-expected-string equality filter; omitted matches every record.

session_id.description: Native resumable session id: dotted-path string pick over matching records; the last match wins.

where.description: Dotted-path-to-expected-string equality filter; omitted matches every record.

tokens.description: Token total: over matching records, sum the required listed integer fields, subtract the optional listed integer fields, and clamp each record at zero. Missing or non-integer fields count 0; a record where no sum path resolves never turns an absent total into zero.

where.description: Dotted-path-to-expected-string equality filter; omitted matches every record.

sum.description: Dotted paths to the token counts to add up.

subtract.description: Optional dotted paths to subtract from each record's sum before clamping it at zero.

duration.description: Wall-clock duration from exactly one of: `field` (a millisecond value; last match wins) or `timestamp_spread` (last minus first RFC 3339 timestamp; needs at least two parseable matches). The exactly-one rule is a Rust loader invariant.

where.description: Dotted-path-to-expected-string equality filter; omitted matches every record.

surfaces_skill_invocation.description: Whether the transcript deterministically surfaces a skill invocation (false routes the meta-check to the LLM-judge fallback). For extract descriptors, leave false unless the mapping verifiably yields invocations named `Skill` carrying an `args.skill` field.

skill_tool.description: Tool name of the deterministic skill-invocation event the `__skill_invoked` meta-check matches (default "Skill" — Claude Code's Skill tool; OpenCode declares "skill").

skill_arg.description: Argument of the skill-invocation tool that carries the staged slug (default "skill"; OpenCode declares "name").

guard.description: Write guard: the data the guard engine renders into the harness's native pre-tool hook surface and a deny verdict. The engine selects the install mechanism: json-hooks (default) merges a hook entry into hooks_file (Claude Code, Codex); opencode-plugin stages an embedded JS plugin at plugin_file. Restricted to embedded built-in descriptors (the guard fails open, so a mistyped user descriptor would silently disarm it).

engine.description: Install mechanism: json-hooks (default when absent) merges hook_entry into hooks_file; opencode-plugin stages the embedded JS plugin at plugin_file.

hooks_file.description: (json-hooks) Hook-config file the entry is merged into, `/`-separated relative to the staged env root (e.g. ".claude/settings.local.json").

matcher.description: (json-hooks) Tool-name matcher the hook registers for; every hooked tool must be declared in [tools] write/patch/shell.

command_template.description: (json-hooks) Shell command the armed hook runs, with {exe} and {marker} placeholders (e.g. '"{exe}" guard "{marker}"').

hook_entry.description: (json-hooks) JSON template of the hook entry appended to the hook config's hooks.PreToolUse array, with {matcher} and {command} placeholders in its string values; authored key order is written verbatim.

plugin_file.description: (opencode-plugin) Plugin file staged from the embedded JS template ({exe}/{marker} substituted), `/`-separated relative to the staged env root (e.g. ".opencode/plugins/slow-powers-eval-guard.js").

verdict_template.description: JSON template of the deny verdict printed on stdout, with a {reason} placeholder; authored key order is the harness's on-disk contract.

preflight.description: Named live-skill collision scanner: claude-plugins, codex-skills, or opencode-skills.

dispatch.description: CLI dispatch guidance: command templates ({model_arg}/{guard_args} slots) and the prose around them.

env.description: Environment defaults applied only to eval-agent dispatches. Later descriptor layers merge by key and run --agent-env overrides them.

capture_prefix.description: Prefix naming the judge recipe's per-task capture files ($response_base.<prefix>-events.jsonl).

guard_args.description: Extra args spliced into command templates at {guard_args} when the run is guarded (leading space included).

model_note.description: Sentence spliced into next_steps_template at {model_note} when an agent model was declared.

exec_template.description: Copy/pasteable single-dispatch command; <eval-root>-style angle placeholders are prose for the human.

parallel_command_template.description: Per-task command block spliced into the shared jq/xargs parallel scaffold.

judge_command_template.description: Judge command line spliced into the shared judge recipe; must reference $model_arg and {cwd} and end with a shell line continuation.

manifest_template.description: The dispatch-manifest harness section; {exec_command}/{parallel_recipe} placeholders; ends with exactly one newline.

conversation.description: Native same-session continuation used by scripted multi-turn evals.

token_usage_aggregation.description: How per-turn token totals combine: sum (default) for independent per-turn usage, or last for cumulative native-session usage.

resume_exec_template.description: One follow-up dispatch command. Must reference <eval-root>, <outputs_dir>, {session_arg}, and {prompt_arg}; {model_arg}/{guard_args} are filled like dispatch.exec_template.
